title: $200K-funded fifth-dimension gravity theory report handed in

tellings.quote: I handed them a report and they said, "Thank you, Dr. Brandenburg. Here's your check. Don't let the door hit you when you go out of the building."

plain: The physicist John Brandenburg says an unnamed government funder paid about $200,000 for his theory that gravity is tied to a fifth dimension. He tells it from his own experience: when he handed in his report, he says, they told him, "Thank you, Dr. Brandenburg. Here's your check. Don't let the door hit you when you go out of the building," and nothing more came of it.
